content: Attention mechanisms were introduced in the deep learning literature to overcome some simplifications imposed by pooling operators. When we humans read a sentence, we are able to spot its most relevant parts in a given context and disregard information that is redundant or misleading. The attention model aims to mimic this behaviour.
